summary.text: Cody Vasut is a Republican member of the Texas House of Representatives who has represented District 25 since January 12, 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as attorney.

paragraphs.text: Cody Vasut was born in Houston, Texas.
He earned bachelor's and master's degrees from Texas A&M University and a J.D. from the University of Houston Law Center.
His career experience includes working as an attorney and owning a business.

In a 2020 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a member of the Angleton City Council and a fifth-generation lifelong resident of Brazoria County who had worked seven years as an attorney with BakerHostetler in Houston.
Vasut succeeded Dennis Bonnen in the Texas House, and his current term ends on January 12, 2027.

In 2021-2022 he served on the Criminal Jurisprudence, Juvenile Justice & Family Issues, and Resolutions Calendars committees, and in 2023-2024 he was vice chair of Business & Industry and a member of Judiciary & Civil Jurisprudence.
